_meta.scope: Vulnerabilities tracked by Indagis Agent across the Python core (pyproject.toml + uv.lock) and the Node.js desktop/web apps (apps/desktop/package.json, apps/desktop/node_modules, plugins/platforms/photon/sidecar/package-lock.json).
_meta.sourcePolicy: Every entry below is sourced from a specific git commit on this branch. No data is invented. Where the source commit groups multiple CVEs without listing them individually (the case for the OpenTelemetry/spectrum-ts sidecar batch), the entry is documented as an aggregate with the count taken verbatim from the commit message.

statusLegend.fixed: The vulnerable version range has been replaced by a patched version in this branch.
statusLegend.documented-debt: The vulnerability is acknowledged open. A mitigation OR a deferral justification has been recorded in a commit on this branch, but the patched version has not yet been adopted.

vulnerabilities.title: Iframe sandbox OpenURL bypass
vulnerabilities.summary: Sandboxed iframes with allow-popups can bypass window-open restrictions in Electron < 41.10.3.
vulnerabilities.notes: Mitigation already in place: setWindowOpenHandler returns {action:'deny'} for ALL window-open requests (main.ts, see inline comment), plus will-navigate preventDefault() on non-local navigation. 41.x deferred — breaking major-version change requiring its own e2e + sandbox-of-untrusted-content review pass.

vulnerabilities.title: PKCS#7 EnvelopedData Bleichenbacher oracle
vulnerabilities.summary: PKCS#7 EnvelopedData decryption exposes a Bleichenbacher oracle through distinguishable errors and timing.

vulnerabilities.title: Session handling credential exposure
vulnerabilities.summary: httplib2 < 0.32.0 mishandles credentials in retry paths.
vulnerabilities.notes: A previous fix (referenced in 37e42808e but not directly reachable from this branch's git history) had pinned the same version in pyproject.toml's google extra and tools/lazy_deps.py. 37e42808e closed the third path (setup.py REQUIRED_PACKAGES) so --install-deps cannot resolve an unpinned range.

vulnerabilities.title: aiohttp RCE via request smuggling
vulnerabilities.summary: aiohttp < 3.14.3 contains multiple high-severity issues including a request smuggling vector reachable from RCE in chained parser/middleware setups.
vulnerabilities.fixCommit: 708633100 (PR #10 reapplied manually after Dependabot PR #4 closed against the old test-orphan branch)
vulnerabilities.notes: Patched across all 5 affected extras (messaging, slack, matrix, homeassistant, sms, teams). tools/lazy_deps.py pin aligned with the core version.

vulnerabilities.title: DoS via unbounded intermediate arrays
vulnerabilities.summary: brace-expansion < 5.0.9 allows unbounded intermediate-array growth on crafted input patterns, leading to a DoS via memory exhaustion.
vulnerabilities.notes: Override pinned in root package.json since 390a1771b (2026-07-31). Listed in .npmrc min-release-age-exclude[] for fast-moving security treatment.

vulnerabilities.title: DoS via infinite loop in custom generators
vulnerabilities.summary: nanoid < 3.3.17 spins in an infinite loop when a custom generator returns a zero-size string.

vulnerabilities.title: Quadratic CPU consumption in !!omap resolution
vulnerabilities.summary: js-yaml >= 4.0.0, < 4.3.1 has quadratic CPU consumption when parsing crafted !!omap inputs.

vulnerabilities.title: Downstream response desynchronization via retry interceptor
vulnerabilities.summary: undici < 6.28.0 contains two distinct desync CVEs in the retry interceptor path. The 7.x lineage is patched (7.29.0 in photon-sidecar), the 6.x copy transitively pinned via node-gyp resolves to 6.28.0, but the direct copy in ui-tui is still undici@6.27.0 (verified via 'npm ls undici' at repo root on this branch).
vulnerabilities.notes: Only PARTIALLY fixed. The direct undici 6.x copy in ui-tui/hermes-tui@0.0.1 is still 6.27.0 as of this commit and remains vulnerable to GHSA-8xcm-r25x-g524. The ui-tui fix requires --force (per 2fcdb4df2's own analysis) and was explicitly deferred to the Electron-41 tranche. Status updated from 'fixed' to 'documented-debt' after 'npm ls undici' confirmed 6.27.0 still resolves at the repo root.

vulnerabilities.title: DOMPurify IN_PLACE hook removal XSS
vulnerabilities.summary: dompurify < 3.4.13 allowed an XSS via the IN_PLACE hook removal path.

vulnerabilities.title: Cross-user info disclosure via Cache-Control
vulnerabilities.summary: undici 7.x (prior to 7.29.0) could leak cross-user response bodies through cache-control misinterpretation.

vulnerabilities.title: Configuration APIs prototype pollution
vulnerabilities.summary: mermaid configuration APIs < 11.16.1 allowed prototype pollution on the configuration object.

vulnerabilities.title: CSS injection in sibling elements
vulnerabilities.summary: mermaid < 11.16.1 allowed CSS injection that escapes into sibling elements in the rendered output.

vulnerabilities.title: Architecture diagrams prototype pollution
vulnerabilities.summary: mermaid architecture diagrams < 11.16.1 allowed prototype pollution via the diagram-specific configuration paths.

vulnerabilities.title: XY Charts infinite loop DoS
vulnerabilities.summary: mermaid XY Charts < 11.16.1 could be driven into an infinite render loop on crafted input.

vulnerabilities.title: Radar diagrams DoS
vulnerabilities.summary: mermaid radar diagrams < 11.16.1 had a DoS reachable on crafted input.

vulnerabilities.title: ProtocolResponse.url default session cache poisoning
vulnerabilities.summary: Electron < 40.10.6 leaked session-cache state into ProtocolResponse.url resolution.

vulnerabilities.title: Aggregate: 17 moderate vulnerabilities remaining in photon-sidecar
vulnerabilities.summary: plugins/platforms/photon/sidecar/ resolves 17 moderate vulnerabilities inherited from the OpenTelemetry bridge and the spectrum-ts 8.x direct dep. The sidecar is self-contained (pre-monorepo consolidation) so the lockfile is separate and not part of the root npm audit scope.
vulnerabilities.notes: Aggregate entry — the commit message documents the count (17 moderate) but does not enumerate individual CVE ids. Each individual entry would need a per-CVE npm audit pull, which is out of scope for a static data pane.

vulnerabilities.title: minimatch high severity path through eslint 10.8.0
vulnerabilities.summary: minimatch 10.0.0 / 10.0.2 is flagged high; the fix requires bumping eslint, which is a deferred follow-up.
vulnerabilities.patchedVersion: newer minimatch in next eslint line (not adopted)
vulnerabilities.fixCommit: e075ec961 (acknowledged as remaining after the desktop audit pass)
vulnerabilities.notes: Deferred to a follow-up commit; the eslint bump has its own test pass requirement.
